pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit jagged, high-frequency edge serrations with sharp-angled protrusions. The relative spatial area of patches is largest on the upper neck, transitioning to significantly smaller, fragmented, and stellate shapes on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light interstitial pathways form a continuous, branching topological graph with frequent irregular junction nodes. Pathway thickness is non-uniform, exhibiting a progressive narrowing from the neck towards the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a persistent, high-frequency serrated profile against the background, characterized by low-amplitude peaks corresponding to individual hair tufts.
